title: Profile notification migration alters a different field than the one it just added
reasoning: Migration 0018 adds receive_upcoming_fast_push_notifications with default=True, but migration 0019 changes receive_upcoming_fast_reminders to default=False instead. If receive_upcoming_fast_reminders does not already exist before these excerpts, applying migrations on a clean database will fail with a missing-field error. Even if that older field exists, the newly added receive_upcoming_fast_push_notifications remains at default=True while the surrounding notification defaults are changed to false, which is likely not the intended schema state.
recommendation: Verify the intended Profile field name and update 0019 to alter receive_upcoming_fast_push_notifications if that is the new push notification field. If receive_upcoming_fast_reminders is intentional, add a separate AlterField for receive_upcoming_fast_push_notifications or document why it remains default=True.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No migration tests or model-state checks are included for this feature, so the typo/mismatch would only surface during a full migration run or schema assertion.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a migration test that applies through 0019 from an empty database and asserts the expected Profile notification fields exist with the intended defaults.
minimumFixScope: Correct the field name in migration 0019 or add the missing AlterField for the newly introduced push notification field.
